en.commentary:
Start with the division, because this category hides its real price behind the shelf tag. Kirkland Signature Ultra Clean ships 194 fl oz rated for 146 loads and lands between 12 and 14 cents a load. Tide Ultra Oxi in the 154 fl oz bottle claims 100 loads and sits near 23 cents. Tide Evo tiles come out around 48 to 62 cents per recommended load. That is close to a fivefold spread across products that all end up in the same drum of cold water for the same forty minutes, and the number printed on the front of the bottle tells you none of it.

The costliest trap in this aisle lives inside one brand. At Walmart a 92 fl oz bottle of Tide Original at $11.97 for 64 loads prices out at 18.7 cents a load. The 50 fl oz bottle of the identical formula at $8.97 for 32 loads prices out at 28 cents. Same front label, same liquid, 50 percent apart. I built the cost per load column first for exactly this reason, and I want readers carrying that one division into the store.

My second column is New York's 1,4-dioxane rule, which became a clean binary in 2026. Household cleansing products sold in the state have been capped at 1 ppm since December 31, 2023, and DEC's finalized regulations close the waiver program, with no waiver effective after December 30, 2025. Every product here is still on New York shelves, which stands as the manufacturer's own representation that it meets the cap. Published third-party values stay scarce, so I treat a missing test result as information in its own right. The greenwashing class actions against Gain and Arm & Hammer Clean Burst rest on 2022 testing at 3.32 ppm and 4.28 ppm, both predating the cap, and both cases remain open with no final judgment.

Third is format. Consumer Reports tested 14 sheets and tiles in 2026. Tide Evo Free & Gentle took the top score in that group on blood, grass and dirt, with coffee and chocolate surviving the wash across the whole category. Arm & Hammer Power Sheets came second and cleared chocolate. Both deliver cardboard packaging, travel convenience and cold water dissolving, and both charge two to three times per load for it. That price is why the liquids hold the top six spots here.

Verdict: Kirkland Signature Ultra Clean wins 2026 on arithmetic that is not close. Tide Ultra Oxi earns the premium on the days the stain actually matters.

highlights.title: Kirkland Signature Ultra Clean wins 2026, and the arithmetic is not close
highlights.body: A 194 fl oz jug rated for 146 loads puts this between 12 and 14 cents a load, which is roughly half of what Tide Ultra Oxi costs to run and about a quarter of a Tide Evo tile. It earns the outright win on performance too: Consumer Reports places it inside the top five for stain removal, with a top score on salad dressing and strong results on body oil. For the ordinary mixed load of office shirts, school clothes and towels, which is the overwhelming majority of what any household washes, this is the detergent I recommend. Costco membership is the only real gate, and in Taiwan the same jug sits on the shelf at NT$459 for 146 loads, which works out to about NT$3.1 a wash.

highlights.title: Tide Ultra Oxi earns 23 cents a load on the days the stain actually matters
highlights.body: P&G puts the highest concentration of surfactants and enzymes it sells into this bottle, and the built-in pre-treaters handle set-in stains in a single step. Across independent stain panels Tide and Persil trade the lead, with Persil averaging about 2 percent more stains removed. Twenty-three cents a load is roughly double the Kirkland number, so my recommendation is to run the cheap bottle as the household default and keep one Ultra Oxi jug for blood, grass, body oil and anything that has already been through a dryer. Buy the 154 fl oz size and the premium per load stays at its lowest.

highlights.title: The 50 oz Tide bottle costs 50 percent more per load than the 92 oz bottle of the same formula
highlights.body: At Walmart the 92 fl oz Tide Original at $11.97 for 64 loads runs 18.7 cents a load. The 50 fl oz version of the identical liquid at $8.97 for 32 loads runs 28 cents. The packaging is the same colour, the same logo and the same claims, and the only thing separating the two numbers is a division nobody performs in the aisle. This pattern repeats across brands and it is the single highest return habit a reader can pick up from this page: divide price by the stated load count before the bottle goes in the cart. P&G's mid single digit price increases from August 2025, taken to offset about $1 billion in fiscal 2026 tariff costs, landed hardest on premium and innovation items including Tide Evo and Tide Pods with Oxi Boost, which widens these gaps further.

highlights.title: New York's no-waiver deadline turned 1,4-dioxane into a yes-or-no fact for 2026
highlights.body: Household cleansing products sold in New York have been limited to 1 ppm of 1,4-dioxane since December 31, 2023, and the DEC regulations finalized in September 2024 end the waiver pathway, with no waiver effective after December 30, 2025. For 2026 that means a detergent on a New York shelf carries the manufacturer's own representation of compliance, which is a firmer signal than any marketing claim on the front panel. Published third-party numbers remain rare, and I score a missing test value as a real gap. The Gain and Arm & Hammer Clean Burst greenwashing class actions cite 2022 independent testing at 3.32 ppm and 4.28 ppm respectively, both measured before the cap took effect, and both actions are pending with no final judgment.

highlights.title: Tiles and sheets buy packaging and convenience at two to three times the price per load
highlights.body: Consumer Reports tested 14 sheet and tile products in 2026. Tide Evo Free & Gentle earned the highest score in that group, removing blood, grass and dirt, with coffee and chocolate surviving the wash for the category as a whole. Arm & Hammer Power Sheets finished second and cleared chocolate stains. Tide Evo is genuinely the most convincing engineering in this format, six cleaning layers spun into fibre, cardboard packaging, no plastic bottle, and faster dissolving than a pod. P&G quotes about 48 cents per recommended load. That is three to four times the Kirkland figure, so I recommend the format to travellers, dorm residents and anyone hauling laundry to a shared machine, and I recommend liquid to everybody washing at home.

highlights.title: Taiwan readers: Costco is the only channel where this ranking's winner is an official local price
highlights.body: Most of the US names on this list reach Taiwan through parallel imports, which is why their prices here are marked as estimates. Costco Taiwan is the exception, listing the Kirkland Signature 5.73 L jug at NT$459 with a stated 146 washes at the level one cup mark, which is about NT$3.1 a load and the same arithmetic win it scores in the US. Taiwan also runs a different regulatory frame: there is no local household-cleanser equivalent of New York's 1 ppm cap, the TFDA residue limit for 1,4-dioxane applies to cosmetics, and the Ministry of Environment's Green Mark specification carries its own restricted substance list for cleaning products. Readers who want a third-party screen locally should look for the Green Mark, then run the same price divided by stated washes calculation on whatever is on the shelf.

zh-tw.commentary:
先講結論，這個品類的真實價格藏在貨架標價後面，你要自己除一次才看得到。Kirkland Signature Ultra Clean 194 盎司標示 146 次，每次落在 12 到 14 美分。Tide Ultra Oxi 154 盎司標示 100 次，每次大約 23 美分。Tide Evo 洗衣磚照 P&G 自己的建議用量算，每次 48 到 62 美分。同樣丟進冷水桶轉四十分鐘的東西，成本差了快五倍，而瓶身正面印的那個數字完全看不出這件事。

這條走道上最花錢的陷阱，出現在同一個品牌裡面。Walmart 的 92 盎司 Tide Original 賣 11.97 美元標示 64 次，每次 18.7 美分；50 盎司的同款配方賣 8.97 美元標示 32 次，每次 28 美分。同樣的瓶身設計、同樣的液體，價差 50%。你想想看，會在貨架前面拿出手機按計算機的人有幾個。我把每次成本這一欄放在第一個位置就是為了這件事，我希望讀者把這個除法帶進賣場。

第二欄是紐約州的 1,4-dioxane 規定，這件事在 2026 年變成一個乾淨的是非題。紐約州對家用清潔用品的 1,4-dioxane 上限自 2023 年 12 月 31 日起為 1 ppm，DEC 定案的規則把豁免機制收掉，2025 年 12 月 30 日之後沒有任何豁免有效。這份名單上每一款目前都還在紐約州的貨架上，這本身就等於廠商自己對合規做出的表述，比包裝正面任何行銷字眼都硬。公開的第三方檢測值仍然很少，所以我把查不到檢測值這件事本身當成一項資訊來打分。Gain 與 Arm & Hammer Clean Burst 的綠洗集體訴訟引用的是 2022 年的檢測值 3.32 ppm 與 4.28 ppm，兩筆都早於上限生效，兩案目前都還在審理中，沒有終局判決。

第三欄是格式。Consumer Reports 在 2026 年測了 14 款洗衣紙巾與洗衣磚。Tide Evo Free & Gentle 在那一組拿到最高分，血漬、草漬、泥污都能處理掉，咖啡跟巧克力則是整個品類共同的難關。Arm & Hammer Power Sheets 排第二，巧克力漬清得掉。這兩款給你的是紙盒包裝、攜帶方便跟冷水快溶，代價是每次成本兩到三倍。說真的，這就是液體款在這份名單前六名全包的原因。

台灣這邊算式不太一樣。好市多的 5.73 公升科克蘭賣 459 元標示 146 次，每次約 3.1 元，同一款在美國拿下的算術優勢，在台灣一樣成立。

highlights.title: 科克蘭 Ultra Clean 拿下 2026 第一，算術上根本沒得比
highlights.body: 194 盎司標示 146 次，每次 12 到 14 美分，大概是 Tide Ultra Oxi 的一半，是一顆 Tide Evo 洗衣磚的四分之一。它能拿第一而不只是便宜，關鍵在 Consumer Reports 把它排進去汙前五名，沙拉醬那項滿分，體垢油汙也拿到高分。一般家庭洗的絕大多數是襯衫、學校制服跟毛巾混在一起的雜衣，這種洗衣量我就推薦這瓶。唯一的門檻是好市多會員卡。台灣讀者更省事，好市多線上就有 5.73 公升裝 459 元、量杯刻度 1 標示約 146 次，換算每次約 3.1 元。

highlights.title: Tide Ultra Oxi 那 23 美分，值在真的有硬漬的那幾天
highlights.body: P&G 把瓶裝產品線裡濃度最高的界面活性劑跟酵素放進這瓶，內建預處理成分讓陳年髒汙一次洗掉。獨立去汙測試裡 Tide 跟 Persil 互有勝負，Persil 平均多清掉約 2% 的汙漬。每次 23 美分大約是科克蘭的兩倍，所以我的建議很直接，日常用便宜那瓶當家裡的預設值，另外留一瓶 Ultra Oxi 專門對付血漬、草漬、體垢，還有已經進過烘衣機的那種頑固漬。買 154 盎司的大罐，每次成本的溢價會壓到最低。

highlights.title: 50 盎司那瓶 Tide，每次成本比 92 盎司同款貴 50%
highlights.body: Walmart 的 92 盎司 Tide Original 賣 11.97 美元標示 64 次，每次 18.7 美分。50 盎司的同一款液體賣 8.97 美元標示 32 次，每次 28 美分。包裝同色、同 logo、同訴求，中間隔的只有一個沒有人會在走道上做的除法。這個型態在各品牌反覆出現，而它也是這一頁讀者最值得帶走的習慣，商品丟進購物車之前，先把售價除以標示載數。補充一個時間點，P&G 自 2025 年 8 月起對約四分之一品項調漲中個位數，用來吸收 2026 會計年度約 10 億美元的關稅成本，漲幅集中在創新與高階品項，包含 Tide Evo 與加了 Oxi Boost 的 Tide Pods，這會讓上面那些差距再拉開。

highlights.title: 紐約州的無豁免死線，讓 1,4-dioxane 在 2026 年變成是非題
highlights.body: 紐約州對家用清潔用品的 1,4-dioxane 上限自 2023 年 12 月 31 日起為 1 ppm，DEC 於 2024 年 9 月定案的規則把豁免路徑關掉，2025 年 12 月 30 日之後沒有任何豁免有效。換句話說，2026 年還擺在紐約州貨架上的洗衣精，等於廠商自己做出了合規的表述，這個訊號比包裝正面任何綠色圖案都硬。公開的第三方數值依然稀少，所以我把查不到檢測值當成一項實質缺口來扣分。Gain 與 Arm & Hammer Clean Burst 的綠洗集體訴訟分別引用 2022 年獨立檢測的 3.32 ppm 與 4.28 ppm，兩筆都在上限生效之前測得，兩案目前仍在審理，沒有終局判決。這一段只陳述法規數值與訴訟階段，健康影響請洽專業人員。

highlights.title: 洗衣磚跟洗衣紙巾，你買到的是包裝跟方便，代價是每次成本兩到三倍

en.commentary:
The ranking holds, and Kirkland Signature Ultra Clean keeps first at 9.1. Last week I gave you the cost per load arithmetic. This week I want to talk about water temperature, because it is the setting that saves you the most money and the one P&G is openly trying to change.

P&G has set a goal for 75% of laundry loads to be washed in cold water by 2030, and it reported reaching 65% in 2024. The reason is energy. Most of the electricity a hot wash uses goes into heating the water, so switching a load to cold cuts that load's energy bill sharply while the washer's motor use stays the same.

Every detergent in my top five cleans well in cold water. Kirkland Ultra Clean and Tide Ultra Oxi both use enzyme blends that work at low temperatures, which is exactly why they score so highly on grass, sebum and food stains. Persil ProClean at third is strong on oily soils. I wash nearly everything cold now and keep warm water for heavily soiled towels and bedding.

Tide evo, at tenth and eleventh, is the product built around this idea. It is a waterless fibre tile with six cleaning layers designed to activate in cold water, sold in a curbside recyclable cardboard box. Retail analysts estimate liquid detergent at about 20 cents a load, pods at about 31 cents and the tiles at about 48 cents. That price is why evo sits where it does, and its convenience and plastic free packaging are why it earns a spot at all. For someone who carries laundry to a shared machine, a tile you drop in the drum is genuinely pleasant to use.

My recommendation: buy a large jug of Kirkland or Tide Ultra Oxi, dose to the line, and set the dial to cold.

我的建議很簡單：在好市多買一大桶 Kirkland 或 Tide Ultra Oxi，照刻度倒，轉到冷水。台灣好市多就買得到 Kirkland，週年慶期間囤貨很划算，一年的量一次搞定。
